0022600003.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons, with the Oklahoma City Thunder traveling to face the San Antonio Spurs. The Thunder are missing Nikola Topic (out, back surgery), Otega Oweh (out, Achilles surgery), and Thomas Sorber (out, knee surgery), while the Spurs are without Jayden Quaintance (out, knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (out, calf strain). The teams met in 2025-26, when the Thunder lost 1-4 in the regular season and 3-4 in the playoffs, and their most recent meeting was a playoff game on May 30, 2026 in Oklahoma City that the Thunder lost 111-103.
